race.title: Mark Sheasby Birthday Celebration Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Ben Pauling's point winner TRUE TO MY WORD can make a winning start under Rules at the chief expense of Pure Ocean , who pulled clear with the winner on her hurdles bow back in the spring. Western Charm should be sharper for her recent hurdles debut and completes the shortlist. TRUE TO MY WORD (IRE) PURE OCEAN (IRE) WESTERN CHARM
